overview.text: The Florida Green Watersnake is a harmless snake of the south-eastern United States and the largest water snake in North America.

identification.text: Plain grey or greenish-brown with a white or yellow belly.

size.label: Adults
size.text: Usually 76 to 140 cm long; the record is 188 cm.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Florida, southern Georgia, Alabama and southern South Carolina.

habitat.text: Calm, weedy water such as swamps and marshes; rarely rivers or streams.

behaviour.text: Active all year in southern Florida; further north it hibernates and basks on sunny winter days.

diet.text: Mainly fish such as sunfish, crappies and small bass, plus frogs, tadpoles and salamanders.
